name: PHRX 4066
title: Pharmacy Practice Management throughout the Career Trajectory
description: This course prepares students for clinician-manager roles in various settings with activities focused on developing practice management, problem-solving, and communication skills using participative management. Furthermore, the course provides students with the opportunity to explore careers in pharmacy and further their professional development.
requirement_description: Open only to students in the PharmD program in the School of Pharmacy.
